findings.claim: L20 still presents behavior differences 1 and 4 as live, including 'Decision for the owner: accept, or make Candidates read only the live rows'. L21 and L22 supersede them, but L20 carries no in-place marker, so a reader of L20 alone sees an open owner decision and two golden regenerations that were later reverted. L20 also reports the acceptance greps (CardMemory and engram/memorycard deps) only for the old commits. L22's final checks do not repeat them on the re-sliced series.

T3 is ticked with no mention that the owner's decision on the Engram sync/promote refusal when a memorycard database exists but cannot be opened (difference 5 in L20) is still pending (L21: 'the owner decides it separately'). The open item appears only in the Log, not on the task line.

evidence: The change only edits the T3 task line and appends Log entries L20-L22 in an odd/ document; no code is touched.
Commit hashes on the task line match the series listed in L22: five code commits, then tests, then spec/README/docs, plus the re-slice note.
The consistency issues are in the Log's stale and pending items.
